_comment: Season 10 weapon sounds: 5 melee hits + 2 abilities. WEAPONS ONLY - both pickaxes deliberately have no custom sound and use vanilla block-break. Fully synthesised from noise + damped inharmonic partials; no sampled, pitched or third-party audio anywhere in this pack. Each impact is a broadband transient crack plus a band-limited noise body plus a comb of mutually inharmonic damped material modes, with the tail's 1/3-octave band energies steered toward a per-weapon target by a measured feedback loop (14 correction iterations + a 3-point tail-scale grid search).
_design_note: Chosen by ear over a 3-way bake-off of four independent generators (tools/qwen, tools/deepseek, tools/make_weapon_sounds.py, sound-approaches/compare.html). Qwen's set won on user score: mean 6.2/10 with no file below 5.0, versus 4.2 (Deepseek) and 1.1 (Space Bunny). The winning region measured across all 15 auditioned files is a spectral centroid of roughly 3000-3500 Hz; the whole-set median of the CC0 reference library (5348 Hz) sits in the band that scored worst, so it is recorded here only as provenance, not as a target.

_notes.hit_cinderfall_waraxe: forged steel; hard broadband crack over a low-mid body, centroid 5052 Hz
_notes.hit_voidreaver_glaive: dark mid-dominant tear, 4184 Hz centroid, deliberately unsettled tail
_notes.hit_glacial_crescent: ice; shortest and brightest, 7615 Hz centroid, no sustained ring
_notes.hit_skyshatter_spear: airy mid whip-crack, 5782 Hz centroid, spam-safe under attribute swapping
_notes.hit_implosion_maul: heaviest melee blow, 5174 Hz centroid, weight from a 0.18 ms attack not sub-bass
_notes.ability_implosion_maul: Singularity smash; 0.55 s, biggest event, secondary inward-collapse beat at 220 ms
_notes.ability_skyshatter_spear: Gale Dash; a SWING not a hit - 86 ms soft attack, no transient, low dominant
